_comment: Per-concept token lists needed to drive search_features/filter_features_by_effect_and_activations. PISCES's own repo never publishes these for any concept except (implicitly) Harry Potter, whose pos_toks are hardcoded in erasing_harry_potter.ipynb's signs-computation cell. search_tokens seeds search_features' vocabulary-projection match; pos_toks feeds get_mlp_act_signs and the pos-token side of filter_features_by_effect_and_activations; neg_toks (near-domain contrastive tokens whose probability should NOT drop) is not present anywhere in pisces_ref and must be curated per concept before that concept can run -- left null on purpose rather than guessed, especially for the sensitive concepts (Suicide, Mass Shooting, Rape, Opioid).
